correctness.rationale: The finite complex is regenerated from the defining 16-vertex graph. An exhaustive 191-pair face-poset matching is checked against every one of the 1200 Hasse covers, and a full topological sort proves the Morse orientation acyclic. Exactly one critical 0-cell and nine critical 3-cells remain, which yields a wedge of nine 3-spheres. A separately constructed mod-2 chain complex has boundary ranks (15,65,95,16) and reduced Betti rank 9 only in degree 3.

value.rationale: The 5-folded cube/Clebsch graph is a canonical symmetric strongly regular graph, and its independent-set enumeration is already tabulated. Determining the full homotopy type therefore supplies genuinely new structural information rather than another count. The result sharpens the general triangle-free suspension theorem to an explicit nine-sphere wedge and gives a compact reproducible benchmark for topology of independence complexes of symmetric graphs.
